item.critfall_horseman.horseman_head.bre: Worn, %s breathes a cone of fire, once a day.
item.critfall_horseman.horseman_head.spe: The head has no fire left until dawn.
item.critfall_horseman.hangmans_rope.lor: It has held more necks than it ever should have.
item.critfall_horseman.hangmans_rope.use: Ropes burst from the ground where you aim. A Strength save, or held in place.
He made these for his children, long before the town took his head.
Eat one, and a d6 decides what it does.
1: A fright. The dark closes in, and someone laughs.
2: The ground lurches, and you are elsewhere.
4: You pass through the living like smoke.
5: The night opens its eyes to you.
6: It tastes of a kitchen long gone. You feel better.
item.critfall_horseman.charges.dawn: Spent charges come back at dawn.

critfall_horseman.config.title: Headless Horseman Settings
critfall_horseman.config.status.applies: Saved to config/critfall_horseman/ and used at once.
critfall_horseman.config.status.server: You are playing on a server, so the server sets the rules. Only your own screen settings are here.
critfall_horseman.config.status.unreadab: A config file has a syntax error, so the defaults show. Save replaces it.
critfall_horseman.config.status.save_fai: Could not save the config. The log says why.
critfall_horseman.config.save.tooltip: Writes the config files and applies them. No restart needed.
critfall_horseman.config.invalid.date: Enter a date as MM-DD, like 10-31.
critfall_horseman.config.invalid.chance: Enter a number from 0 to 1, like 0.1.
critfall_horseman.config.key.enabled.too: Master switch. Off, he never comes and his fight does nothing.
critfall_horseman.config.key.natural_spa: He comes by himself at midnight. Off, only spawn eggs and /summon bring him.
critfall_horseman.config.key.halloween_n: The day he comes for certain. MM-DD.
critfall_horseman.config.key.every_hallo: On Halloween he comes at every in game midnight. Off, only at the first.
critfall_horseman.config.key.season_star: First night he may come by chance. MM-DD.
Last night he may come by chance. MM-DD; the season may run over New Year.
critfall_horseman.config.key.all_year.to: Every night counts as in season.
critfall_horseman.config.key.season_chan: His chance at each midnight in season, from 0 to 1.
critfall_horseman.config.key.hoofbeats.t: Hoofbeats and mist before he appears. Off, he appears at once.
critfall_horseman.config.key.sunrise_exi: If he is still alive at sunrise, he rides off.
critfall_horseman.config.key.fire_damage: His sword hits add fire damage while he has his head.
critfall_horseman.config.key.charge.tool: He charges on his steed; a Dexterity save avoids being knocked down.
He throws his head in a line of fire; a Dexterity save halves it.
critfall_horseman.config.key.sweep.toolt: He sweeps his sword all around him when someone crowds him.
critfall_horseman.config.key.head_passin: Players can pick up his head and throw it. Off, it can't be picked up.
critfall_horseman.config.key.drops.toolt: He drops rewards when he dies, from the loot table rewards/horseman.
critfall_horseman.config.key.per_player_: Everyone who hurt him or carried his head gets their own drops, theirs alone for 2 minutes. Off, one set for anyone.
critfall_horseman.config.key.lantern_lig: His worn head can be lit with a key. Needs a dynamic light mod to light the world.
critfall_horseman.config.key.lantern_bre: Once a day his worn head breathes a cone of fire; a Dexterity save halves it.
critfall_horseman.config.key.hangmans_ro: Three times a day, ropes hold creatures in place; a Strength save resists.
critfall_horseman.config.key.treats.tool: Three treats a day, each with one of six effects from a d6.
critfall_horseman.config.key.boss_bar.to: Boss bars for him and his steed.
critfall_horseman.config.key.lines.toolt: His lines as titles and on the action bar, with their sounds.
critfall_horseman.config.key.effects.too: Bursts of fire, smoke and mist from his moves, seen by every player.
critfall_horseman.config.key.fog.tooltip: Fog closes in on your screen when he is near.
critfall_horseman.config.key.camera_shak: Your camera shakes when he charges nearby.
critfall_horseman.config.key.ambient_par: The smoke, embers and fire trails around him and his head.
